//: Overrides the Backrooms mod's weather, which Level 0 and Level 1 share (Level 2 copies it and sets its own heat). Office air: about 21 C all year with the seasons cancelled (the game adds up to -12 C in midwinter and +12 C in midsummer; spring and autumn are near 0), and only calm weather, so no snow or rain cools the air. On official builds the day-night swing and random drift remain (roughly 14-28 C, usually 17-25 C); the Xbro10 fork holds it steady (the flag below).

Xbro10 fork: the weather generator default_backrooms (Level 0 and Level 1) always gives its base temperature, with no day-night, seasonal or random swings, as underground levels already do (src/weather_gen.cpp, weather_generator::steady_temperature). Official builds load the flag and ignore it.
